data.long_meaning: Diminutive form of Marie, derived from the Hebrew name Maria, meaning ‘bitter’ or ‘rebellious’ due to Mary’s submission to God’s will in the face of adversity. The name Mariette carries the meaning “Mary little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mariette usually hope their child will grow to embody mary little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Mariette carries a rich spiritual meaning, highlighting the strength and profound submission to God’s will. It serves as a reminder of Mary's resilience in the face of challenges, exemplifying the virtues of humility, faith, and obedience. The name Mary, and thus Mariette, is a testament to the transformative power of faith and devotion. Mariette can inspire individuals to embrace their own challenges with the same steadfastness and trust in God, ultimately leading to personal growth and spiritual enrichment.
